name: Protect PDF
task: Lock a PDF with a password
tagline: Add a password to a PDF, so only people who know it can open the file.
seoTitle: Protect PDF with a password, no upload
description: Lock a PDF with a password for free in your browser. 256-bit AES encryption. Your file and your password are never uploaded.

specs.First load: 1.3 MB, then cached by your browser
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. The PDF is locked inside this browser tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere. Your original file is not touched.
No. The password stays in this browser tab. It goes to the locking engine on this page and nowhere else. The page never saves or logs it, and the fields are cleared as soon as you use them.

faq.q: What if I forget the password?
faq.a: Then nobody can open the file again, not even this site. A strong password can't be guessed or recovered. Keep the password somewhere safe, and keep an unlocked copy of the original if you may need it.
Any current PDF program that supports 256-bit AES: Adobe Acrobat and Reader, Preview on Mac, Chrome, Edge, Firefox and most phone apps. Very old programs may not open it.

faq.q: Do the print, copy and change choices lock the file?
faq.a: No. They are a request that most PDF programs follow, and some ignore. The password is what keeps the file closed. Choose a long password that is hard to guess.
